gates.evidence: Proposal targets s10 Image Creation Hub, which is SFW and age-appropriate.
Reward is 1 AI Image credit (resource r3), with no cash-like items or incentivized clicks/installs.
Offer uses gain framing ('Earn an image credit') with a clear decline option ('No thanks').
User opts in explicitly via the 'Play Now' CTA on the offer modal.
Offer explicitly states: 'Play 2 quick games with Luzia to get 1 free AI image generation credit.'
Decline button 'No thanks' returns the user directly to s10 with no penalty or degraded state.
Triggered when hitting the quota limit (r3) on image generation, not mid-stream.
Eligibility specifies non-paying users who have exhausted their free AI Usage Quota (r3).

scores.evidence: Proposal targets moment m21 on s10 Image Creation Hub when the user's AI Usage Quota (r3) is depleted.
Proposal uses mini-games with Luzia as Game Partner, keeping the experience native and immersive on s10.
Restricted to non-paying users with a daily cap of 2 credits and a 2:1 view bundle, plus a 10% holdout.
Code flags a deficit: cost to serve the reward ($0.0250) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063) at the low end.
Image creation is a frequent core loop activity (m21, s10), hitting a broad share of active users.
Maps directly to SIM-RWD with button entry, SSV (REWARD_VERIFIED), and a defined patch.
Uses app-specific nouns and IDs: s10, r3, Image Creation Hub, Luzia.
Explicit per-day cap of 2 and a 30-minute cooldown.
Defines primary metric, guardrails (paid conversion, DAU, retention), and a 4-week holdout.

requiredChanges: Increase the view requirement or switch to a cheaper mini image model to resolve the unit economics deficit where the cost to serve ($0.0250) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063).
parsed.topConcern: Unit economics deficit: the cost to serve an image generation ($0.0250) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063), making the 2-view bundle financially unsustainable.
